task.title: Record the real-model locator quality gate on L1
task.objective: At 858ffd17 verify:ai-locator-quality-live proves the real Qwen3.5-0.8B's locator plans on real pages: six real Recorder captures on /recorder-lab/locator-upgrade through runLocatorUpgradeAttempts, the production AiService and the real ai-host.cjs, every compiled plan proven by proveLocatorPlan / proveRepairPlan in real Chromium and each accepted candidate judged by the page on a fresh page. It passed 14/0 twice with 0 false targets, the twins refused, 3-4 of 5 solvable scenarios browser-proven and 5 of 6 jobs taking a real second attempt, behind five scripted controls. Append a note to awkit-djnl.1 giving the gate, the results and what stays open (the pin, the license notice, verify:ai-model-pack and verify:ai-model-live on the 0.8B, verify:ai-authoring-quality-live and verify:ai-error-quality-live not built, the owner's go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress with a note naming the gate commit and its live results, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, against the state after `bd update awkit-djnl.1 --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents. The tracker measured 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, so the hardcoded tracker pin did not move. Both narratives restate the measured 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: locator quality gate noted on awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
